branches.description: Default branch. Arcs, power systems, rivals, hundreds of episodes, tie-in films, the Big Three argument. Talk-about units; never requires watching.
Moral grey, mystery and thriller structure, sci-fi and cyberpunk canon, asking about heavy stories kindly. Survey depth, non-graphic.
Comfort shows, romance beats, school and music-club life, shojo and josei classics.
Ghibli-fan vocabulary, theatrical anime and the box office, auteur film language, festivals and the Oscars.

editorial.copyrightPolicy: Publisher article text, synopses, review text and aggregator blurbs are never copied; Swoon'd writes its own explanation and links. No stills, key art, posters, character art, trailers, clips, OP/ED or soundtrack audio, lyrics or voice clips are displayed or hosted.

masteryModel.usefulCompetenceStatement: I can follow and join a conversation about anime: I understand the shelves, genres, studios, seasons and fandom vocabulary people use, I know how to ask honest, curious questions, and I can enjoy the conversation without pretending to have watched everything.

licensingConstraints.constraint: No stills, frame grabs, key art, posters, character art or fan art. All images are original Swoon'd illustrations (license id original-swoond). Titles are text only.
No OP/ED, soundtrack, sound effects or voice clips from any show. Listening exercises use original recorded or synthesised audio (original-swoond), skippable with a text alternative.
Song lyrics are never quoted or summarised at length.
No trailers or clips are embedded or hosted; link-out to official channels only, no autoplay.
Never copy publisher articles, synopses, review text or aggregator blurbs; explain in Swoon'd words and link.

AniList API is free for non-commercial use and for apps under about $150 per month revenue; above that a commercial licence is required, and mass collection, storage and use in competing trackers are prohibited. MyAnimeList API licence is non-commercial and forbids scraping; Jikan is an unofficial scraper and is not a production dependency. Kitsu commercial terms are unclear and need confirmation. Wikidata (CC0) and Wikipedia (CC BY-SA) are allowed with attribution. Checked 2026-09-30.
Studio, publisher, streaming-service and franchise logos are trademarks: text-only mentions.
Creators and voice actors appear as public professional facts only; no likeness, endorsement or fabricated quotes.
Community scores and lists (AniList, MyAnimeList, Kitsu) belong to their providers and users: no scraping or mirrored tables; link out. Never link to unlicensed streaming or scanlation sources.

safetyConstraints: Mature themes (war, loss, violence, suicide, abuse) are discussed at survey depth, non-graphic, with a content-note line before any lesson that names one; skippable without loss.
Fanservice is covered only as a taste debate at a non-explicit level; it is never described or shown.
Never push mature-rated titles at a learner of unknown age; teach ratings literacy instead.
Never suggest or link to unlicensed sources; teach why official releases support creators without lecturing.
Real events and people (for example the Kyoto Animation history) are discussed with care and never dramatised.
Listening items use original audio, loudness-capped, with a skip option and a text twin with equal mastery credit.
